sources.snippet: Short-wave infrared (SWIR) imaging provides access to spectral information beyond the range of human vision and conventional CMOS sensors. Its ability to penetrate materials and perform reliably under low-light conditions has made it valuable in applications such as industrial inspection and night-time surveillance.
